decisions.issues: Accepted on the final attempt with faults. v05 is the only version that shows the script beat: Ramayyan holds a single cord-tied ola with a red wax seal and no stylus, Nagoji stands apart at the back by a pillar in the rust-red turban, Varma sits on the low dais with his spear at his right hand, and the hall matches the open-sided sea-view hall of 5.4, 5.5 and 6.1. No text, blood or noose. Nagoji's chin is clean-shaven and nothing hangs from his ear, but the stud is too small to see at this scale. The remaining faults: (1) Varma's hair is loose and shoulder-length with no knot visible. The script and the hard check want a side knot above his LEFT ear, and the neighbouring panels show a knot. His left side faces away from the camera, so a knot could only show as a lump on the far side, and none is drawn. (2) The Nair chieftains wear their knots at the crown or back of the head, not as front kudumi topknots. (3) There is a small dark smudge, like a hair tuft, on Ramayyan's bald crown. (4) A small brass pot on the table holds a stick like a stylus (it is not in Ramayyan's hand). Why the others are worse: v03 gives Nagoji a hanging gold hoop earring and has Ramayyan breaking the seal on a bound bundle. Varma's knot on his left is correct in v03. v04 gives Nagoji a small hanging drop earring, has Ramayyan holding a stylus over a bound bundle, and puts Varma's knot at the back of his crown. Both fail hard checks, so no backup is given.

Small remaining faults in v04, accepted on this final attempt. (1) Nagoji's ear ornament is one small round gold bead. It sits at the very bottom of the lobe, so at high zoom it could read as a tiny drop rather than a perfectly flush stud. Nothing else hangs from it, and at print size (about 4 px in a 2172 px frame) it reads as a stud. (2) The distant soldiers at the camp fires are too small to show whether they are bare-headed Nair with topknots or men in caps or turbans. This is minor background detail. Everything else checks out. Nagoji is seen from behind, walking left toward the camp fires, with the long pale empty beach and the black sea running away to the right. He is in the commander look: rust-red turban, cream tunic, red sash, cream trousers, boots and talwar at the hip. His lost profile shows the curled moustache and a clean-shaven chin. The two camp flags are plain white, with no saffron, red or orange. There is no text, no ship on the sea, and his hands, legs and boots are sound. The open night sky in the upper right (about x 0.40 to 0.98, y 0.03 to 0.30) takes the single caption well. The other candidates were rejected. v02 shows him from the front, walking away from the fires toward the camera, which inverts the script beat. v03 has red pennants over the camp and an earring that dangles.
